name: Stealth Title
epitaph: Changed hands once in NSW's own surviving record: Chris Crosse lost it to Spawn in a cage match at Bone Bash 2003, the ENDCAP off the top of the cage ending both the match and the reign.
notes: Sourced entirely from Spawn's own April 2003 bio card (promotions/nsw/archive/spawn-bio-card.html), including its embedded "Flash Back" full match script.

name: Tag Titles
epitaph: Won and vacated in the same stretch of the record: Brad Douglas took it alone in a battle royal at Bone Bash, then gave it up chasing the World Title — a push the fed's own closure cut off before it paid out.
notes: Sourced entirely from Brad Douglas's own April 2003 bio card (promotions/nsw/archive/brad-douglas-bio-card.html); no card or results page for the battle royal itself survives.
